evidence.title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research

summary: Inherent, a startup founded by former DeepMind researchers, announced that its AI “teammate” achieved higher scores than leading models from Anthropic and OpenAI when tasked with replicating scientific research. The result highlights the potential of specialized AI assistants to accelerate research workflows.
title: Inherent’s AI teammate outperforms Anthropic and OpenAI in research replication tasks
